summary: The PR fixes the issue with stackplot not respecting the Axes cycler, but introduces a minor maintainability/readability defect.

issues.description: The change introduces a minor maintainability/readability defect by using a separate variable for the color cycle, which could be avoided by using the existing axes._get_lines.get_next_color() method directly.

The change does not follow the project convention of using the existing axes._get_lines.get_next_color() method to get the next color in the cycle, instead introducing a new variable for the color cycle.
The change does not add any new tests, but the existing tests should still cover the new behavior.
